title: Waikapū 80-home workforce project subsidy and deadline
summary: As of the November 26, 2024 meeting, the developer said construction could start within 8 to 12 months once grant money can be drawn. The project is an 80-unit development that is 100% residential workforce housing. It is backed by a $10.65 million county grant.
